title: Mandiri Bintan Marathon 2026 Review: What the 2025 Race Was Like
seo_title: Mandiri Bintan Marathon Review: Course, Weather, Cut-offs
meta_description: Mandiri Bintan Marathon review: the 2025 race at Lagoi Bay, about 3,000 runners, a 4.45am start at 27°C and 88% humidity, 321 m of climbing, a 6.5-hour cut-off and water every 2.5 km.
dek: What running Bintan Resorts' marathon at Lagoi Bay was like in November 2025: the new AIMS-measured course and its climbing, the warm and humid early start, the aid stations and cut-offs, and the ferry, shuttle and race-pack logistics for a weekend on Bintan.
verdict: Enter if you want a small, well-supported resort marathon an hour's ferry ride from Singapore. The 2025 race drew about 3,000 runners, nine in ten of them Indonesian, to a new course around Lagoi Bay with water every 2.5 km and a generous six-and-a-half-hour marathon limit. Do not expect a fast or cool run: the marathon map shows 321 m of climbing, and at the 4.45am start it was about 27°C with 88% humidity, rising past 31°C by 11am. The 2025 results are no longer online, so there is no public record of how fast the field ran.

sections.heading: The Course: New Roads Around Lagoi Bay, With Some Climbing
paragraphs: The 2025 race was the fourth Mandiri Bintan Marathon, run by Bintan Resorts and iSport with Bank Mandiri as title sponsor [2]. The 3 km family run and 5 km fun run were on Saturday 8 November, and the 10 km, half marathon and marathon on Sunday 9 November [1]. The organiser put the field at 3,000 runners, a 25% increase on the previous edition, with Indonesians making up about 90% of it [2]; the Bintan regency council's report on the day said more than 3,000 [1], and a local news site reported runners from 16 countries [3]. The 2024 edition had drawn 2,400 [14].

2025 brought a new course. The organiser said it had been measured to AIMS standards for the marathon, half marathon and 10 km, had relatively lower elevation than the 2024 route and smooth road surfaces, and would be the standard route for the next five years [2]. Before the race the iSport race director said the marathon's elevation had been cut from 330 m to 320 m, and the half marathon's from 180 m to 170 m [6].

The race guide's marathon map starts and finishes at Plaza Lagoi and labels Ria Bintan Golf Club, Danau Sentosa (a lake), a reservoir and the Lagoi township along the route; it gives an elevation gain of 321 m for the marathon, 175 m for the half marathon and 72 m for the 10 km [4]. The Bintan council described the Sunday races as running along Bintan's coast and hills [1], and a Media Indonesia feature said the route passed the Lagoi coastline, mangrove forest and coastal villages [8].

The organiser's 2025 FAQ described a swift, level course [7]. That does not square with 321 m of climbing on its own map: this is a rolling course, not a flat one, and it is better suited to a steady run than a fast time.

sections.heading: The Weather: Warm and Very Humid From the Start
paragraphs: Open-Meteo's historical model for the grid point nearest Lagoi, which is an estimate rather than a station reading, gives 27.1°C, 88% humidity and a dew point of 24.9°C in the 4am hour on race morning, with full cloud cover and a wind of about 6 km/h [9]. The temperature stayed between 26.5°C and 27.4°C until 8am, with light rain of 0.4 mm in the hour to 7am and 0.2 mm in the hour to 8am [9].

It then warmed quickly: 29.0°C at 9am, 30.5°C at 10am and 31.7°C, with 59% humidity, at 11am, shortly before the marathon closed at 11.15am [9]. A dew point near 25°C means sweat barely evaporates, so even the first hours of this race are hard work. Anyone expecting to take more than about four hours should plan their pace and drinking for heat in the closing stages.

sections.heading: Aid Stations, Cut-offs and Results
paragraphs: The race guide placed hydration stations every 2.5 km, with medical staff at key points and at the finish [4]. Its marathon map also marks sponge, fruit and sprinkler points and toilets [4]. The organiser said there would be misting, wet-sponge and snack stations on the course, and a recovery area with ice baths and physiotherapy for marathon and half-marathon finishers [2].

The marathon started at 4.45am, the half at 5.15am and the 10 km at 5.45am, and each start line closed five minutes after the gun [4]. Cut-offs ran from the gun: six and a half hours for the marathon, four hours for the half marathon and two and a half hours for the 10 km [4]. The race-categories page gave the same marathon and half-marathon limits but two hours for the 10 km [5], so check the 2026 figure before you set a pace. The 5 km and 3 km had no cut-off [4].

Timing used MYLAPS chips on the bib [4]. After the race the official site linked to a 2025 results page on a separate results server [10]; that server no longer loaded on 6 November 2026, and we found no other published copy and no news report naming the winners or their times. This review therefore gives no finish times, finisher counts or winning marks.

There was prize money for the top five men and women in each Sunday race, with marathon winners in both the International and National categories receiving IDR 10,000,000; the Open category was open to all runners and the Closed category to Indonesian citizens only, and runners aged 40 and over had their own Master podiums [5].

sections.heading: Race Weekend Logistics
paragraphs: Race packs were collected at the ballroom of the Four Points by Sheraton Bintan on Friday 7 and Saturday 8 November, from 10am to 8pm, with an ID card or passport and the registration confirmation [4]. There was no collection on race day, and anyone collecting for someone else needed an authorisation letter and a copy of the runner's ID [4]. The organiser's earlier FAQ had given Plaza Lagoi as the collection point [7], so check the 2026 location in the race guide.

On race morning the race village at Lagoi Bay opened at 4am, and bag drop ran from 4am to 11.30am [4]. Runners got a free electric shuttle pass, with extra race-morning buses leaving the resort hotels between 3am and 3.45am; the guide put travel time at about 30 to 45 minutes and advised arriving early [4]. Runners were not allowed to stay overnight in the event area [7].

From Singapore, Bintan Resort Ferries runs from Tanah Merah Ferry Terminal to Bandar Bentan Telani terminal in about 60 minutes; Bintan is one hour behind Singapore, so the 4.45am start is 5.45am Singapore time [11]. There are also ferries from Pasir Gudang in Johor, speedboats from Batam to Tanjung Uban, and flights from Jakarta to Tanjungpinang, about an hour's drive away [11]. The official hotel was the Four Points by Sheraton Bintan, Lagoi Bay, near the event venue, and the partner list ran from Angsana, Banyan Tree and Cassia to budget options such as Bintan Service Apartment and the two-star D'primaHotel Lagoi [12].

The 2025 marathon cost IDR 750,000 in the first price tier (11 to 14 June) on one of two published price lists, rising to IDR 1,300,000 in the third tier (1 August to 30 September) on the other [13]. The marathon entry included a bib, running shirt, runner gift, finisher medal and finisher tee [5].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you live in Singapore, Johor or Batam and want a marathon you can reach by ferry, with a generous cut-off, frequent water and a resort weekend attached. The field is small and mostly Indonesian, so expect quiet stretches on the course.
Think twice if you want a personal best. The course climbs 321 m, the race starts at about 27°C with a dew point near 25°C, and there are no public results to show what times are realistic.

The 2026 race, the fifth edition, is on Saturday 21 and Sunday 22 November, and the organiser expects more than 4,000 runners [15]. The published schedule keeps the 2025 start times: marathon 4.45am, half marathon 5.15am and 10 km 5.45am on the Sunday [16]. Race packs are collected at Plaza Lagoi on Friday 20 and Saturday 21 November, from 10am to 8pm [16][17]. The site now gives the Tanah Merah ferry as about 1 hour 10 minutes, with up to four sailings a day and check-in 1.5 hours before departure [15]. The 2026 schedule does not yet list cut-off times [16], and the organiser said in 2025 that the new course would be used for five years [2].

Nobody from this site ran the race. This review draws on the organiser's race guide, archived web pages and press releases, a regency council report, Indonesian news reports and modelled weather data. We found no first-hand runner accounts we could read and cite.

pull_quotes.quote: For runners, the new course offers relatively lower elevation compared to last year, while maintaining smooth road conditions, and it will serve as the standard route for the next five years.
pull_quotes.attribution: Pandu Bagus Buntaran, iSport race director, in a Bintan Resorts release before the 2025 race

faqs.question: What time does the Mandiri Bintan Marathon start?
faqs.answer: Very early. In 2025 the marathon started at 4.45am local time on the Sunday, the half marathon at 5.15am and the 10 km at 5.45am, all from Plaza Lagoi, and each start line closed five minutes after the gun. Bintan is an hour behind Singapore. The 2026 schedule keeps the same start times.

faqs.question: What are the cut-off times at the Mandiri Bintan Marathon?
faqs.answer: In 2025 the marathon limit was six and a half hours from the 4.45am gun, so 11.15am, and the half-marathon limit was four hours. The race guide gave the 10 km two and a half hours, while the race-categories page said two hours. The 5 km and 3 km had no cut-off. The 2026 limits are not yet published.

faqs.question: How hot is the Mandiri Bintan Marathon?
faqs.answer: Warm and very humid. Open-Meteo's model for Lagoi gives 27.1°C, 88% humidity and a dew point of 24.9°C at 4am on race morning in 2025, under full cloud with a little light rain before 8am. By 11am, shortly before the marathon closed, it was 31.7°C. These are modelled figures, not station readings.

faqs.question: Is the Mandiri Bintan Marathon course hilly?
faqs.answer: Moderately. The 2025 race guide gives the marathon 321 m of elevation gain, the half marathon 175 m and the 10 km 72 m. The course, new in 2025, starts and finishes at Plaza Lagoi and passes Ria Bintan Golf Club, Danau Sentosa and a reservoir. The organiser says it will stay in use for five years from 2025.

faqs.question: How do you get to the Mandiri Bintan Marathon from Singapore?
faqs.answer: By ferry. Bintan Resort Ferries sails from Tanah Merah Ferry Terminal to Bandar Bentan Telani in Bintan Resorts; the organiser gave the crossing as about 60 minutes in 2025 and about 1 hour 10 minutes in 2026, with up to four sailings a day. In 2025 free electric shuttles linked the resort hotels with the race village.

faqs.question: Where are the Mandiri Bintan Marathon 2025 results?
faqs.answer: They are not online any more. After the 2025 race the official site linked to results on a separate server, which no longer loaded in November 2026, and we found no other published copy or news report giving the winners' times. Runners who need their 2025 time should contact the organiser at the address on bintan-marathon.com.

editorial_notes: Written 6 November 2026 about the previous edition (Saturday 8 and Sunday 9 November 2025, the fourth edition), for runners deciding on the 2026 race. The 2025 finish-time results are not publicly available: the results server linked from the official site no longer loads, and no news report naming winners or times was found, so no finisher counts, medians or winning times are given. Field size is the organiser's figure (3,000); the regency council said more than 3,000. Weather is Open-Meteo modelled reanalysis for the grid point nearest Lagoi, not an observation. The 2025 race guide (flipbook at raceguide-mbm-2025.sadaraga.co.id) is the source for the course maps, elevation, cut-offs, aid and race-pack details; where it differs from the earlier race-categories page (10 km cut-off) or FAQ (race-pack venue, 'level' course) both are stated or the guide is preferred. The two 2025 price lists on the registration page are not labelled in the archived copy, so only the range is given. Pages from the old 2025 site are cited from Internet Archive copies because the site was rebuilt for 2026. The ferry time differs between the 2025 site (60 minutes) and the 2026 site (about 1 hour 10 minutes); both are given. A short YouTube vlog of the 2025 race exists, but no written first-hand runner account (blog, Reddit, Strava write-up) was found, so none is quoted. No rating.
